_comment: Middleware config — read by `node dist/core/main.js` (default path ~/.config/wcppm/config.json). The WeChat server connection lives HERE now, not in openclaw.json.
_bridge_comment: Downstream interface the OpenClaw adapter (and other bots) connect to.
_heartbeat_comment: Heartbeat conductor (default-off). Enable to keep the WCPPM longlink alive via periodic /api/Login/HeartBeat calls.
